name: Dear my『 』
source:
"I write a letter. To face her." Read the letter that arrived for the protagonist, write a reply, and spend time with her. Where will her letters lead the protagonist? Find out in the game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866180/Dear_my/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我写了一封信。去见她。”阅读寄给主角的信，写一封回信，并与她共度时光。她的信将带领主角走向何方？在游戏中找出来吧。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866180/Dear_my/]Steam[/url]]
